unresolved_layers.boundary: The 2025–2030 implementation plan has an official KPI-based PDCA framework, but a canonical published annual result for the current implementation-plan cycle has not yet been resolved and prior 2020–2024 cycle results must not be substituted.

quality_boundary: This partial inventory confirms the current basic plan, current 2025–2030 implementation plan, official PDCA governance route, fiscal 2026 budget, and fiscal 2024 settlement. It does not substitute the prior implementation cycle for current annual progress or promote KPI, project, budget, settlement, governance, or outcome records to Reviewed, linked, comparable, causal, or policy-achievement status.
next_action: Resolve the first canonical annual result for the 2025–2030 implementation-plan cycle, then review KPI definitions, implementation projects, fiscal-plan records, fiscal 2026 budget records, and fiscal 2024 settlement evidence at record level while preserving the 2020–2024 versus 2025–2030 cycle boundary.
